scores.tell: Thin curved lamp arm and scroll are slightly wobbly; otherwise crisp, tight bevels and slim parts.
Slim rails and flat panels match the real cards. Seat edge tube is a little thick.
Chair legs and frame are fattened into thick sausage tubes. Seat and back are puffy pillows. The whole chair reads as a toy.
Bottles are plausible, but the caps and shoulders are rounded and soft. Labels are swollen. Silhouettes are fairly clean.
Helmet is a near-perfect sphere on a squat base, so it is very round and blobby. The visor is a swollen bubble.
Roof, base slab and posts keep flat planes and straight runs. Corners are slightly soft.
Gloves are inflated and balloon-like. The cuffs are thick rings. Everything is rounded and soft, with no tight corners.
Planks and posts are straight. The posts are slightly bulbous, but the proportions are believable.
Clock rim is a thick, fat torus. The face is flat and crisp, and the rim is a bit puffy.
Rails are thin and straight, with crisp joints. Seat fabric is slightly rolled at the edges.
